title: typeof and Array.isArray Check
description: Predict typeof tags and when Array.isArray is required.

questions.prompt: What is the result of `typeof null`?
questions.explanation: Legacy quirk: `typeof null` is `"object"`. Never use `typeof` to detect null — compare with `=== null`.
Arrays are objects under `typeof`. Use `Array.isArray` to detect arrays.

questions.prompt: What is the result of `Array.isArray({ length: 2 })`?
questions.explanation: Array-like objects are not arrays. `Array.isArray` returns `true` only for real arrays.

questions.prompt: Which check correctly reports an array (not a plain object)?
questions.explanation: `typeof` never returns `"array"`, and `"object"` also matches plain objects and `null`. Prefer `Array.isArray`.

questions.prompt: In a safe `describe(value)` helper, what order should you check?
questions.explanation: Check `null` first (because `typeof null === "object"`), then arrays, then fall back to `typeof`.

questions.prompt: What is the result of `typeof Number`?
questions.explanation: `Number` is a built-in function (constructor). Functions get the special tag `"function"`.
